findings.issue: AC-4 smoke command uses endpoint `/api/me` (line 95 of task 5: `curl -i -s http://localhost:8080/api/me`), but the actual endpoint is `/api/auth/me`. `AuthController` is annotated `@RequestMapping("/api/auth")` with `@GetMapping("/me")`, making the full path `/api/auth/me`. The `ProfileController` base is `/api/profile`. There is no controller mapped to `/api/me` anywhere in the codebase. This smoke command will return 404, not 200 OK, causing AC-4 to appear failed even when the implementation is correct.
findings.fix: Replace `http://localhost:8080/api/me` with `http://localhost:8080/api/auth/me` in the AC-4 smoke block of task 5 (line 95). Also update the comment on line 94 from `/api/me` to `/api/auth/me`.

findings.issue: Task 4 Description item 6 instructs auditor to verify `AuthServiceTest` at `≈line 306` and `≈line 343` for REMEMBER_ME_ATTR assertions. The current pre-Task-1 state of `AuthServiceTest` shows those tests at lines 306 and 344 respectively, but they contain NO `exchange.getAttributes()` mock setup — `mockExchangeWithSessions` only mocks `getRequest()` and `getSession()`, not `getAttributes()`. After Task 1 adds the attribute write, the existing mock exchange will be missing `getAttributes()` stub, which will cause a NullPointerException or unsatisfied mock at runtime. The task does not warn the auditor to check for this mock gap.
findings.fix: Add a hint in task 4 Details section: auditor should verify that `mockExchangeWithSessions` (or the exchange mock used in the two extended login tests) stubs `exchange.getAttributes()` to return a mutable map, so the `verify(...).put(REMEMBER_ME_ATTR, ...)` assertions can succeed. If the stub is absent, flag as blocker in the audit report.

findings.issue: Task 4 requires verifying the new `register_autoLogin_writesRememberMeFalseAttribute` test in `AuthServiceTest`. However, `AuthServiceTest` covers only login flows — the register tests live in `AuthServiceRegistrationTest` (a separate class found at `backend/src/test/java/com/botfunnel/auth/AuthServiceRegistrationTest.java`). The task description says the new register auto-login case should be in `AuthServiceTest`, which may be inaccurate. If Task 1 places it in `AuthServiceRegistrationTest` instead, the auditor looking only at `AuthServiceTest` will report a missing test as a blocker — a false positive.
findings.fix: Clarify in task 4 Details (and the corresponding tech-spec Testing Strategy) that the register auto-login regression case may live in either `AuthServiceTest` or `AuthServiceRegistrationTest` — both are valid locations. Auditor should check both files. Or, if the intent is specifically `AuthServiceTest`, note that `AuthServiceRegistrationTest` is the existing dedicated file for register flows and Task 1 must place it there.

findings.issue: AC-5 smoke (task 5 line 104) uses `POST /api/auth/logout` with a `Cookie` header but no CSRF token. The actual security config uses CSRF protection on state-changing endpoints. The smoke may return 403 FORBIDDEN rather than the expected `Max-Age=0` cookie if the CSRF filter is active on the local stack.
findings.fix: Add a note in the AC-5 smoke that the CSRF token must be included (or that CSRF is disabled for the local bootRun profile). Check `application.properties` or `SecurityConfig` for `CSRF_DISABLED` env var behavior in dev. Alternatively, show how to fetch the XSRF-TOKEN cookie first and pass it as a header.
